# Assessment Overview

Supplementary documents generated for the eShopModernizedWebForms assessment.

- [Architecture Diagram](architecture-diagram.md) — High-level architecture and component relationships.
- [Core Business Workflows](business-workflows.md) — Catalog browsing, item administration, image upload, and business rules.
- [Configuration & Externalized Settings Inventory](configuration-inventory.md) — Configuration sources, runtime options, externalized secrets, and startup dependencies.

- [Dependency Map](dependency-map.md) — External NuGet dependencies grouped by function, version risks, and test dependencies.
